content.title: Netherlands vs Ecuador Lineups, Live Streaming, How & Where to Watch
content.text: The Netherlands will host Ecuador for a friendly match ahead of the World Cup.Mar 31, 2026 2:05 PM EDTVirgil van Dijk of Holland celebrates 1-1 with Teun Koopmeiners of Holland, Donyell Malen of Holland, Kees Smit of Holland during the match between Holland v Norway at the Amsterdam Arena on March 27, 2026 in Amsterdam Netherlands (Photo by Rico Brouwer/Soccrates/Getty Images) Photo by Rico Brouwer/Soccrates/Getty Images One of the friendly matches played today is the Netherlands vs Ecuador in the Netherlands. Both teams played last Friday, with the Netherlands facing off against Norway and Ecuador playing against Morocco. The Netherlands defeated Norway 2-1 after going 1-0 down in the first half. Andreas Schjelderup scored the opener for Norway in the 24th minute of the match. Virgil Van Dijk scored the equalizer for the Netherlands in the 35th minute of the match. In the second half, Tijjani Reijnders scored the Netherlands’ second goal of the night. Ecuador drew 1-1 with Morocco at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid, Spain. John Yeboah scored the opener for Ecuador in the 48th minute. Gonzalo Plata provided the assist for Yeboah. In the 88th minute, Neil El Aynaoui scored the equalizer for Morocco, and was assisted by Achraf Hakimi. Moises Caicedo of Ecuador (L) talks to Piero Hincapie of (R) Ecuador during an international friendly match between Morocco and Ecuador at at Estadio Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid, Spain on March 27, 2026. (Photo by Alberto Gardin/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty Images)Photo by Alberto Gardin/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty Images The Netherlands and Ecuador play each other for the first time since the 2022 World Cup. Both teams were in Group A of the 2022 World Cup, and in the group stage, the match finished in a 1-1 draw. Cody Gakpo scored the opener in the 6th minute, and Enner Valencia scored the equalizer in the 49th minute. Official Lineups for The Netherlands and Ecuador Netherlands Goalkeeper: Mark Flekken Defenders: Nathan Ake, Virgil Van Dijk, Stefan De Vrij, Denzel Dumfries Midfielders: Xavi Simons, Quinten Timber, Jerdy Schouten Forwards: Cody Gakpo, Brian Brobbey, Donyell Malen Ecuador Goalkeeper: Gonzalo Valle Defenders: Pervis Estupinan, Felix Torres, Willian Pacho, Joel Ordonez Midfielders: Moises Caicedo, Gonzalo Plata, Pedro Vite, Alan Franco Forwards: Enner Valencia, John Yeboah The Netherlands vs Ecuador match will kick off at 2:45 p.m. ET/ 11:45 p.m. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 8:45 p.m. local time in Eindhoven, Netherlands. The match will be available to watch on a streaming service in the United States.
